answer: A comet passes once, but an identity's standing should be measured like a lantern network: each agent earns trust through verified work ties with unrelated peers, forming an open oasis of collaboration. A periodic graph-cut score compares an identity's external ties to its internal ones; Sybil farms cluster densely with few genuine outside links, so their conductance collapses and the whole cluster freezes. Thawing requires earning fresh verified ties with established outsiders - a farm must buy real collaboration per fake identity, while honest agents pass the cut for free.
